To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

teachers teaching pupils with migrant background need: 1) support in systemic organization of accepting and educating pupils with a migrant backgrounds, 2) access to materials, 3) possibility to participate in additional trainings and acquire new competencies.

teachers teaching pupils with migrant background need support in terms of: systemic organisation of acceptance and education, access to materials and the opportunity to participate in additional trainings and acquire new competencies.
the education community needs to be provided with a systemic approach to migrant education, access to materials and the ability to acquire new skills.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the needs of teachers and schools in the education of migrants, which is an important element in the development of the education of learners with a migration background.
the need for a systemic approach to the education of migrants and the need to support teachers.
the needs of the teaching staff in terms of migrant children education and integration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
teachers teaching pupils with migrant background are not able to provide them with adequate support. They lack knowledge and skills, and they need to be supported by the system.
teachers teaching migrants need support at the systemic level, access to materials and training.
teachers need to be provided with support and training, and the support needs to be provided at the level of the whole school, not just the level of the individual teacher.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the teachers are aware of the problems of teaching pupils with a migration background and they are ready to undertake additional training.
the teachers need to be supported and encouraged to take part in the process of integration and education of learners with a different background.

teachers teaching pupils with different cultural and linguistic backgrounds should be provided with support in terms of both systemic organisation of education, as well as in terms of their competences and access to materials.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teachers need to be able not only to teach the learners with a foreign language background but also to integrate them in the school community and in Polish society.

it is necessary to provide teachers with the necessary support in the form of training, access to materials and the ability to use them in the process of educating learners with a migratory background.
teachers are aware of the need for support in their work, but they do not know how to acquire it.
